item.tib: lung rig bstan pa'i ba dan srid rtser phyar / las dbang sman mo chab dkar sngags kyi sde / lung rgyud ma chad shel dkar 'phreng rgyus lha / las ldan spyod pa'i gzungs mchog 'di kho na
item.coloph: ces pas lung rig bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan bru ston rgyal ba'i dgongs 'dus gtsor bzhag / rgyal ba gnyis pa skyabs ston ratna khi khar gyis lhan du 'thab pa'i dge legs 'phel …
item.note: mentioned in the colophon is skyabs-ston ratna khi-khar, which should be skyabs-ston rin-chen 'od-zer in tibetan.
